name: Cel by Date!
source:
Anna's starting to feel old. She's been going to conventions for years and she's exhausted, but is her anime hobby really the thing she needs to move on from?

Cel by Date! is an age-gap romance between two women having a rough night at an anime convention. Together,  maybe they can figure out how to enjoy themselves again.

[From [url=https://katcantcode.itch.io/cel-by-date]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
安娜开始觉得自己老了。她多年来一直参加会议，已经筋疲力尽，但她的动漫爱好真的是她需要摆脱的吗？

塞尔按日期！讲述了两个女人在动漫大会上度过一个艰难夜晚的年龄差距爱情故事。在一起，也许他们可以找到如何再次享受生活的方法。

[来自[url=https://katcantcode.itch.io/cel-by-date]itch.io[/url]]
